title: Conformance test pack, version 1
description: A counterparty's own rules for ISO 20022 messages, checked on top of the base standard: the messages it takes, the base issue codes it accepts, and rules on any element or attribute. Read by the ISO 20022 Test Bench (CLI --pack, GitHub Action, POST https://iomarkets.tech/api/conformance).
$comment: Released under CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain): https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/. Governed by IoMarkets.org: https://iomarkets.org/formats

name.description: The pack's name; runs are compared with the last run of the same name.

messages.description: Message identifiers the counterparty takes; anything else fails. Absent or empty: any the Test Bench checks.

ignore.description: Base issue codes the counterparty accepts.

id.description: Stable id, shown with every failure.

path.description: Element names under the message's root element, joined by /, optionally ending in /@Attribute.

pattern.description: A regular expression the value must match.

why.description: Why the counterparty asks for it; shown with the failure.
